selection: Footwear query regex, accessory exclusions; stable hash seed 606, independently per original split. No rank-based selection; not category ground truth.

pre_inference_scope_exclusions.hidden shoes: Adhesive barefoot sole pads, outside footwear scope
pre_inference_scope_exclusions.black suede shoe strap: Ambiguous detachable accessory vs strapped footwear

preprocessing: HTML tag removal/entity decoding/whitespace only; title, brand, color, bullets, description. Token fitting recorded at index time. No invented attributes; no images or prices in original ESCI.
scope: Union of all candidates for selected footwear queries, including non-footwear distractors, sandals and children. Not an adult-only footwear catalog.
